input: Assess the credit and counterparty risk of Beyond Meat

financials.metric: Net revenues, Q3 2026 (quarter ended 26 Sep 2026), down 8.1% year over year from $70.2M
financials.stated_by: Beyond Meat Q3 2026 earnings release (8-K Exhibit 99.1, 2026-11-04)

financials.metric: Net revenues, first nine months of 2026, down 10.4% year over year
Loss from operations. Includes $57.1M of non-cash impairment and a $21.8M credit from a lower litigation accrual
Adjusted EBITDA (loss), compared with -$33.5M in Q3 2025
Cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash
Total debt, carrying value net of discount: 2027 Notes $14.5M (current), 2030 Notes $209.6M, delayed draw term loans $89.8M
0% Convertible Notes due 15 Mar 2027 still outstanding, classified current
financials.stated_by: Beyond Meat Q3 2026 earnings release; CFO Lubi Kutua on the Q3 2026 call

financials.metric: Net cash used in operating activities, compared with $101.2M in 9M 2025
Q4 2026 net revenue guidance, low end (range about $54M to $59M)
Cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash at year-end 2025
Minimum liquidity covenant under the Loan and Security Agreement. Cash used to repay the 2027 Notes is capped at $60M; cash interest on subordinated and unsecured debt is capped at $20M a year

debt_events.summary: Closed a $100M senior secured delayed-draw term loan from Unprocessed Foods, LLC (an Ahimsa Foundation affiliate). Interest is 12.0% before initial maturity and 17.5% after, paid in kind. Initial maturity is 7 Feb 2030, extendable to 7 May 2035 by mutual consent. Carrying value was $89.8M net at 26 Sep 2026.

Distressed-style debt exchange completed (final settlement 30 Oct 2025). About $1.117B of the $1.15B 0% Convertible Notes due 2027 (97.16%) were swapped for about $209.2M of new 7.00% Convertible Senior Secured Second Lien PIK Toggle Notes due 2030 plus about 316.9M new shares. $32.66M of 2027 Notes remained outstanding.

FY2025 10-K: $29.459M of 2027 Notes outstanding. The company says it expects to raise significant additional capital, cannot assure it will succeed, and may not be able to refinance the 2027 Notes on satisfactory terms. It no longer qualifies for Form S-3, so its ATM program is unavailable.

Second Supplemental Indenture for the 2030 Notes (trustee Wilmington Trust). It removed restrictions on repurchasing or exchanging the 2027 Notes for cash or equity, and extended the interest make-whole period from 15 Oct 2028 to 15 Jan 2029.
1-for-30 reverse stock split took effect. The conversion rates on the 2030 and 2027 Notes were adjusted.

Exchanged $15.0M principal of 2027 Notes for about 1.55M common shares, leaving $14.5M due 15 Mar 2027. Earlier in 2026, conversions of part of the 2030 Notes produced non-cash gains on debt extinguishment ($63.8M for 1H 2026, per the Q2 10-Q).

payment_behaviour.summary: Vegadelphia (Sonate) trademark case over a Dunkin' ad: a Nov 2025 jury awarded about $39M. Judge Talwani cut actual damages to $37,500, leaving about $15.44M (disgorgement) owed by Beyond Meat; further motions or appeals were possible. In a separate matter, Beyond Meat won its arbitration-related dispute with a former co-manufacturer over ending a production agreement.
Q3 2026 results include a $21.8M credit from a reduced litigation accrual. I found no supplier non-payment complaints, liens or collection suits on any page I opened.

distress_signals.summary: Filed NT 10-Q (late filing) for Q3 2026. It needs more time to finish closing its books, including the accounting for a long-lived asset impairment and lease modifications. It expected to file by 10 Nov 2026, possibly later. The notice does not mention going concern or a restatement.

$57.1M non-cash impairment in Q3 2026 and $20.8M of accelerated rent from a partial termination of the El Segundo headquarters lease. Revenue fell for another quarter. The CFO cited lost club-store distribution for burger and dinner sausage, fewer retail outlets for breakfast sausage, and lower sales to international quick-service restaurant customers.

Interim Chief Transformation Officer John Boken (appointed Aug 2025, also interim COO from May 2026) stepped down. Brijesh Krishnaswamy became full-time COO on 30 Sep 2026. CFO Lubi Kutua is still in the role; I saw no CFO departure.

The FY2025 10-K discloses existing material weaknesses in internal control over financial reporting (inventory provision). It also lists repeated workforce cuts: about 65 staff (Nov 2023), about 44 (Feb 2025), about 40 (Aug 2025), and about 20 from ending China operations at end-2025.

Cut about 6% of global headcount in North America and appointed AlixPartners' John Boken as interim Chief Transformation Officer to lead restructuring. This was at least the third staff reduction in three years.
1-for-30 reverse split carried out to address the Nasdaq minimum bid price. The company also cannot use its ATM equity program because it no longer qualifies for Form S-3.

ownership.value: Publicly traded on Nasdaq (BYND), led by CEO Ethan Brown. No PE sponsor or change of control found. The October 2025 exchange and the 2030 Note conversions issued large amounts of stock to former noteholders. The senior secured lender is Unprocessed Foods, LLC (Ahimsa Foundation affiliate), which also holds warrants from the term loan. Distributor Big Geyser received warrants for about 4.17M shares in June 2026.

output.risk_rationale: Beyond Meat went through a distressed-style exchange in October 2025, swapping about $1.12B of 2027 converts for about $209M of secured PIK notes plus equity, and it still loses money: Q3 2026 Adjusted EBITDA was -$24.6M, revenue fell 8.1%, and it has a $6.6M stockholders' deficit. Debt of $313.9M exceeds cash of $154.6M, and the company cannot use its ATM program, needed a reverse split, has material control weaknesses and filed late again (NT 10-Q, Nov 2026). Near-term default risk is lower because cash burn has slowed to $37.3M over nine months, most debt pays interest in kind and matures in 2030, and only $14.5M of 2027 Notes is due in March 2027, so the call is elevated rather than high.
